pyq_focus: Unit 2 (Poetry) se NET mein har paper mein 8-12 sawaal aate hain, isliye yeh sabse scoring unit hai.
Sabse zyada poochha jata hai: poem kis poet ki hai, famous line kis poem ki hai, aur collection kis saal chhapa.
Chronology wale sawaal (Milton, Pope, Romantic, Victorian, Yeats ke collections) almost har saal aate hain - saal yaad karo, kam se kam decade.
Match-the-following mein poet-poem, poem-character (Belinda, Achitophel, Sporus, Satan, Duke of Ferrara) aur stanza-poem jodne ko kehte hain.
Prosody aur forms bhi pakke hain: sonnet types, ottava rima, terza rima, Spenserian stanza, villanelle, sprung rhythm, metrical feet.
Romantic poets (Wordsworth ka Preface, Keats ki letters, Shelley ka Defence) aur Eliot-Yeats-Pound ka modern poetry sabse heavy area hai.
Indian English (Ezekiel, Ramanujan, Kamala Das, Kolatkar, Mahapatra) aur postcolonial (Walcott, Soyinka, Brathwaite) se 2018 ke baad zyada sawaal aaye hain.
Assertion-Reason mein dhyan do: dono sahi hon to bhi check karo ki R sach mein A ko explain karta hai ya nahi.
Taiyari ka tareeka: har din ek age padho, phir isi file ke works, quotes aur people ko flashcard ki tarah revise karo, aur MCQs do baar lagao.

easy.title: Old English Poetry (c. 450-1066)
easy.story: Bahut purane zamane mein England mein log aag ke paas baith kar veer yoddhaon ki kahaniyan gaate the, jaise hamare gaon mein Alha-Udal gaaye jaate hain. Sabse badi kahani Beowulf hai - ek hero jo Grendel naam ke rakshas, uski maa aur aakhir mein ek dragon se ladta hai. Is kavita mein rhyme nahi hoti, ek hi aawaz se shuru hone wale shabd (alliteration) baar baar aate hain. Samudra ko 'whale-road' kehte the - isko kenning kehte hain. Caedmon's Hymn sabse purani English kavita hai jo Bede ne likh kar bachayi.
easy.trick: 'Bade Gande Dragon' = Beowulf ne Grendel, (Grendel ki maa) aur Dragon ko mara; aur 'C se Caedmon, C se sabse Pehla' yaad rakho.

easy.title: Middle English Poetry (1066-c. 1500, excluding Chaucer)
easy.story: 1066 mein Normans aaye aur French bolne lage, to English thodi badal gayi - jaise Hindi mein Angrezi shabd ghus gaye. Is daur mein bahadur knights ki kahaniyan (romance) chalti thi. Sir Gawain and the Green Knight mein ek hara aadmi kehta hai 'meri gardan kaato, ek saal baad main tumhari kaatunga'. Langland ki Piers Plowman ek sapne ki kahani hai jisme garib kisaan sabse achha insaan hai. Gower ne Confessio Amantis likhi.
easy.trick: 'Green Gawain, Sapna Langland, Gower ka Confession' - Gawain hara, Langland sapne mein, Gower confession karta hai.

easy.title: Geoffrey Chaucer (c. 1343-1400)
easy.story: Chaucer ko English poetry ka 'baap' kehte hain (Dryden ne yeh kaha). Socho ek bus mein alag alag log tirth yatra par ja rahe hain - knight, miller, Wife of Bath, Pardoner - aur time pass ke liye har koi ek kahani sunata hai. Yahi The Canterbury Tales hai. Host Harry Bailly kehta hai jiski kahani sabse achhi hogi use free khana milega. Troilus and Criseyde ek dukhi prem kahani hai jo rhyme royal mein hai.
easy.trick: 'CT = Canterbury Tales = Chalti Train ki kahaniyan'; 'RR = Rhyme Royal = Raja ka ababbcc'.

easy.title: Renaissance and Elizabethan Poetry
easy.story: Renaissance matlab nayi roshni - Italy se sonnet England aaya, jaise bahar se naya fashion aata hai. Wyatt aur Surrey sonnet laye, aur Surrey ne blank verse (bina rhyme ki pentameter) shuru ki. Spenser ne The Faerie Queene likhi jisme har knight ek guna (virtue) hai. Sidney ne Astrophil and Stella sonnets likhe aur Shakespeare ne 154 sonnets. Marlowe ne 'Come live with me and be my love' likha.
easy.trick: 'Wyatt-Surrey Sonnet laaye, Surrey ne Sur bina rhyme ka (blank verse)'; Shakespeare ke sonnet = 154 = 'ek sau chauvan, ladki-ladka dono ke naam'.

easy.title: Metaphysical and Cavalier Poets
easy.story: Metaphysical poet ajeeb, dimaagi tulna karte the - Donne kehta hai do premi compass ke do pairon jaise hain, ek ghoomta hai to doosra bhi jhukta hai. Isko conceit kehte hain. Dr Johnson ne inka naam 'metaphysical poets' rakha. Herbert, Vaughan, Crashaw dharmik kavitayein likhte the. Cavalier poets (Herrick, Lovelace) raja ke saathi the aur halki-phulki prem kavitayein likhte the: 'Gather ye rosebuds while ye may' - jab tak jawani hai maze karo.
easy.trick: 'Donne ka Dimaag, Herrick ki Hasi' - Metaphysical = dimaag wale conceit, Cavalier = masti wale gaane.

easy.title: John Milton (1608-1674)
easy.story: Milton andha ho gaya tha phir bhi usne sahayakon ko bol kar Paradise Lost likhwayi. Yeh Adam-Eve ke swarg se nikaale jaane ki kahani hai, aur Satan ka character itna dumdaar hai ki log use hi hero samajh lete hain. Pehle edition mein 10 books thi, baad mein 12. Lycidas uske dost Edward King ke doobne par likha shok-geet hai. Samson Agonistes mein andha Samson hai - bilkul Milton jaisa.
easy.trick: 'Comus-Lycidas-Lost-Samson' = 'Kal Lado, Lo Saza' (1634, 1637, 1667, 1671) - order yaad rahega.

easy.title: Neoclassical (Restoration and Augustan) and Transitional Poetry
easy.story: Is daur mein kavita bahut niyam se chalti thi, jaise school ki uniform - har do line rhyme karti thi (heroic couplet). Dryden aur Pope ne logon ka mazaak udane wali kavita (satire) likhi. Pope ki The Rape of the Lock mein ek ladki Belinda ke baalon ki lat kaatne ko itna bada bana diya jaise koi mahayuddh ho - yeh mock-epic hai. Baad mein Gray, Collins, Cowper aaye jinmein prakriti aur dukh wapas aane laga - inhe transitional ya pre-Romantic kehte hain.
easy.trick: 'Dryden-Pope = Dono Pakke Couplet wale'; 'Baal ki lat = Belinda ki lat = Rape of the Lock'.

easy.title: Romantic Poetry I: Blake, Wordsworth, Coleridge
easy.story: 1798 mein Wordsworth aur Coleridge ne Lyrical Ballads chhapi aur kaha - kavita aam aadmi ki bhasha mein, gaon aur prakriti ke baare mein ho. Wordsworth ko daffodils aur pahad pasand the, Coleridge ko jaadu aur rahasya, jaise Ancient Mariner jo albatross maar kar musibat mein padta hai. Blake ne bachpan ki masoomiyat (Innocence) aur duniya ki kadwahat (Experience) ke geet likhe - Lamb aur Tyger. Yeh sab feelings ko sabse upar rakhte the.
easy.trick: '1798 = Lyrical Ballads = Romantic ka janamdin'; Blake = 'Lamb masoom, Tyger khatarnak'.

easy.title: Romantic Poetry II: Byron, Shelley, Keats
easy.story: Yeh teeno jawani mein hi chal base - jaise teen tez tare jo jaldi bujh gaye. Byron bagawati aur mazakiya tha, Don Juan aur Childe Harold likhe. Shelley krantikaari tha - 'If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?' Keats sundarta ka pujari tha aur 1819 mein usne mahaan odes likhe; 25 saal mein TB se mar gaya. Shelley ne Keats ki maut par Adonais likha.
easy.trick: 'BSK = Bada Sundar Kavi': Byron 1824, Shelley 1822, Keats 1821 mein mare - ulta order: K-S-B.

easy.title: Victorian Poetry
easy.story: Queen Victoria ke raaj mein science aur dharm ki ladai chal rahi thi, isliye kavita mein shak aur chinta aayi. Tennyson ne dost Hallam ki maut par In Memoriam likha. Browning ne dramatic monologue ko mashhoor kiya - My Last Duchess mein Duke apni maari hui biwi ki tasveer dikha raha hai. Arnold ki Dover Beach mein vishwas ka samundar peechhe hat raha hai. Hopkins ne sprung rhythm banaya.
easy.trick: 'TBA = Tennyson-Browning-Arnold = Victorian ki Top Bench Army'; Browning = 'Bolta akela, sunta chupchaap' (dramatic monologue).

easy.title: Modern Poetry (1900-1939): Yeats, Eliot, Pound, Imagism, War Poets
easy.story: Pehle vishwa yuddh ke baad duniya toot-phoot gayi, aur kavita bhi tukdon mein likhi jane lagi. Eliot ki The Waste Land ek toota hua shehar hai jahan April sabse kroor mahina hai. Pound ne kaha 'Make it new' aur Imagism mein chhoti, saaf tasveer jaisi kavita likhi. Yeats Irish poet tha jisne kaha 'Things fall apart'. Owen jaise sainik kaviyon ne yuddh ki sachchai dikhayi.
easy.trick: 'YEP = Yeats, Eliot, Pound - Modern ke teen YEP!'; Nobel: Yeats 1923, Eliot 1948 - '23 ka jawan, 48 ka budhaa'.

easy.title: Thirties and Post-War British Poetry
easy.story: 1930s mein Auden aur uske dost (Spender, MacNeice, Day-Lewis) politics aur samaj par likhte the - jaise college ke left-wing dost. Dylan Thomas bahut bhaavuk aur sangeetmay tha - 'Do not go gentle into that good night' apne bimaar pita ke liye. 1950s mein Movement ke poet (Larkin) bilkul seedhi, aam zindagi ki baat karte the. Ted Hughes janwaron ki taaqat aur Heaney Ireland ki mitti ke baare mein likhte the.
easy.trick: 'Auden ka Group, Larkin ka Movement, Heaney ka Digging' - teen daur teen naam.

easy.title: American Poetry
easy.story: America ki kavita ne apni alag pehchaan banayi. Whitman ne free verse mein poore desh ko gale lagaya - 'I celebrate myself'. Emily Dickinson ghar mein band rehkar chhoti chhoti dash wali kavitayein likhti rahi. Frost gaon ke raaston aur deewaron ki baat karta hai. Baad mein Ginsberg ke Beat poets aur Plath, Lowell jaise confessional poets ne apne dard ko khul kar likha.
easy.trick: 'Whitman = Wide (khula free verse), Dickinson = Dash, Frost = Farm' - teen W-D-F.

easy.title: Indian English Poetry
easy.story: Angrezon ke zamane mein Indian logon ne bhi English mein kavita shuru ki. Derozio pehle bade kavi the, Toru Dutt ne Our Casuarina Tree likha, aur Sarojini Naidu 'Nightingale of India' kehlayin. Tagore ko Gitanjali par 1913 mein Nobel mila. Azaadi ke baad Nissim Ezekiel ne modern Indian English poetry shuru ki - Night of the Scorpion mein maa ko bichhu kaat leta hai. Kamala Das, Ramanujan aur Kolatkar (Jejuri) bhi zaroori hain.
easy.trick: 'DTS-TE' = Derozio, Toru, Sarojini, Tagore, Ezekiel - purane se naye tak; Ezekiel ka bichhu, Kolatkar ka mandir (Jejuri).

easy.title: Postcolonial and Commonwealth Poetry
easy.story: Jin deshon par angrezon ka raaj tha - Caribbean, Africa, Australia - wahan ke kaviyon ne English mein apni kahani boli, jaise koi ghar ki boli mein sasural ki shikayat kare. Walcott (St Lucia) ne Omeros mein Homer ki kahani Caribbean machhuaron par likhi aur 1992 mein Nobel jeeta. Soyinka ki Telephone Conversation mein ek angrez makaan-malkin rang poochhti hai. Brathwaite ne 'nation language' ki baat ki. Okot p'Bitek ki Lawino apne pati Ocol ke angrezi tareekon par taane maarti hai.
easy.trick: 'Walcott = Waves (Caribbean samundar), Soyinka = Sound (telephone), Lawino = Lady ki shikayat'.

easy.title: Prosody and Metre
easy.story: Kavita ki chaal ko metre kehte hain, jaise dil ki dhadkan 'da-DUM da-DUM'. Ek kamzor aur ek zor wala syllable mile to iamb banta hai, ulta ho to trochee. Paanch iamb ek line mein = iambic pentameter, jo English ki sabse common line hai. Bina rhyme ki iambic pentameter ko blank verse kehte hain. Line ke beech ka ruk-na caesura hai, aur line ka agli line mein beh jana enjambment.
easy.trick: 'Iamb = i-AM (main hoon), Trochee = TRO-chee (pehle zor)'; 'Anapaest = 2 chhote 1 bada, Dactyl = ungli jaisa: 1 bada 2 chhote'.

easy.title: Poetic Forms, Stanzas and Genres
easy.story: Kavita ke alag alag dibbe hote hain, jaise tiffin ke khane. Sonnet 14 line ka dibba hai, villanelle 19 line ka jisme do lines baar baar aati hain. Ode kisi cheez ki tareef ka lamba geet hai, elegy maut par shok-geet. Ottava rima mein 8 line (abababcc), terza rima mein teen-teen line ki zanjeer. Mock-epic chhoti baat ko mahakavya jaisa bada bana deta hai.
easy.trick: '14 Sonnet, 19 Villanelle, 39 Sestina' - 'Ek Chaar, Ek Nau, Teen Nau'; 'Ottava = Octo = 8'.

quotes.quote: Whan that Aprill with his shoures soote / The droghte of March hath perced to the roote
Of Mans First Disobedience, and the Fruit / Of that Forbidden Tree
The mind is its own place, and in it self / Can make a Heav'n of Hell, a Hell of Heav'n
Better to reign in Hell, then serve in Heav'n
Death be not proud, though some have called thee / Mighty and dreadfull
Had we but World enough, and Time, / This coyness Lady were no crime
Gather ye rosebuds while ye may, / Old Time is still a-flying
quotes.source: To the Virgins, to Make Much of Time, Hesperides (1648)

quotes.quote: Stone walls do not a prison make, / Nor iron bars a cage
True wit is Nature to advantage dressed, / What oft was thought, but ne'er so well expressed
Know then thyself, presume not God to scan; / The proper study of mankind is man
quotes.source: An Essay on Man, Epistle II (1733-34)

quotes.quote: The paths of glory lead but to the grave
quotes.source: Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard (1751)

quotes.quote: Full many a flower is born to blush unseen, / And waste its sweetness on the desert air
quotes.source: Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard (1751)

quotes.quote: Tyger Tyger, burning bright, / In the forests of the night
The Child is father of the Man
quotes.source: My Heart Leaps Up (Poems, in Two Volumes, 1807)

quotes.quote: Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting
Water, water, every where, / Nor any drop to drink
quotes.source: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner (1798)

quotes.quote: In Xanadu did Kubla Khan / A stately pleasure-dome decree
that willing suspension of disbelief for the moment, which constitutes poetic faith
If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
My name is Ozymandias, King of Kings; / Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair!
Beauty is truth, truth beauty, - that is all / Ye know on earth, and all ye need to know
Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness
My heart aches, and a drowsy numbness pains / My sense
'Tis better to have loved and lost / Than never to have loved at all
To strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield
Nature, red in tooth and claw
That's my last Duchess painted on the wall, / Looking as if she were alive
Ah, love, let us be true / To one another!
The world is charged with the grandeur of God
Let us go then, you and I, / When the evening is spread out against the sky
quotes.source: The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock (1915)

quotes.quote: April is the cruellest month, breeding / Lilacs out of the dead land
quotes.source: The Waste Land, I. The Burial of the Dead (1922)

quotes.quote: This is the way the world ends / Not with a bang but a whimper
All changed, changed utterly: / A terrible beauty is born
That is no country for old men
The apparition of these faces in the crowd; / Petals on a wet, black bough
quotes.source: In a Station of the Metro (1913)

quotes.quote: What passing-bells for these who die as cattle?
If I should die, think only this of me
Do not go gentle into that good night
quotes.source: Do not go gentle into that good night (1951)

quotes.quote: What will survive of us is love
quotes.source: An Arundel Tomb, The Whitsun Weddings (1964)

quotes.quote: Between my finger and my thumb / The squat pen rests; snug as a gun
I celebrate myself, and sing myself
quotes.source: Song of Myself, Leaves of Grass (1855)

quotes.quote: Because I could not stop for Death - / He kindly stopped for me
quotes.source: Because I could not stop for Death (pub. 1890)

quotes.quote: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood
quotes.source: The Road Not Taken, Mountain Interval (1916)

quotes.quote: And miles to go before I sleep
quotes.source: Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening, New Hampshire (1923)

quotes.quote: I saw the best minds of my generation destroyed by madness
I am Indian, very brown, born in / Malabar
I remember the night my mother / was stung by a scorpion
quotes.source: Night of the Scorpion, The Exact Name (1965)

quotes.quote: Sometimes I think that nothing / that ever comes into this house / goes out
quotes.source: Small-Scale Reflections on a Great House, The Striders (1966)

mcqs.q: In which Old English poem does the Cross itself narrate the Crucifixion?
mcqs.exp: Dream of the Rood mein Cross khud bolta hai; Vercelli Book mein milta hai.

mcqs.q: The 'bob and wheel' stanza ending is a feature of:
options: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
mcqs.exp: Gawain poet har stanza ke end mein chhota 'bob' aur 'wheel' lagata hai.

mcqs.q: Chaucer's The Book of the Duchess is an elegy for:
mcqs.exp: Blanche John of Gaunt ki patni thi; Chaucer ki pehli badi poem.

mcqs.q: Chaucer addresses 'moral Gower' and 'philosophical Strode' at the end of:
mcqs.exp: Troilus ke end mein Chaucer Gower aur Strode ko kitaab sudharne ko kehta hai.

mcqs.q: The first English blank verse is found in:
options: Surrey's translation of Aeneid Books II and IV
mcqs.exp: Surrey ne Virgil ke Aeneid ke translation mein pehli baar blank verse use kiya.

mcqs.q: Tottel's Miscellany (Songes and Sonettes) was published in:
mcqs.exp: 1557 - pehli printed English poetry anthology, Wyatt-Surrey ke sonnets.

mcqs.q: How many sonnets does Sidney's Astrophil and Stella contain?
mcqs.exp: 108 sonnets + 11 songs. 154 Shakespeare ke, 89 Spenser ke Amoretti, 44 EBB ke.

mcqs.q: 'Since there's no help, come let us kiss and part' is a sonnet by:
mcqs.exp: Drayton ke sequence Idea ka famous sonnet.

mcqs.q: 'Batter my heart, three-person'd God' is the opening of a poem by:
mcqs.exp: Donne ka Holy Sonnet XIV.

mcqs.q: 'I saw Eternity the other night' opens:
mcqs.exp: Vaughan, Silex Scintillans (1650) - 'Like a great ring of pure and endless light'.

mcqs.q: The pattern poem 'Easter Wings' was written by:
mcqs.exp: Herbert ki The Temple (1633) mein; lines pankh ki shape banati hain.

mcqs.q: The irregular (so-called Cowleyan) Pindaric ode was introduced into English by:
mcqs.exp: Cowley ki Pindarique Odes (1656). Gray ne baad mein regular Pindaric likhi.

mcqs.q: The first edition of Paradise Lost (1667) was divided into:
mcqs.exp: 1667 mein 10 books; 1674 ke second edition mein 12.

mcqs.q: In Samson Agonistes, the giant of Gath who taunts Samson is:
mcqs.exp: Harapha giant hai; Manoa Samson ka pita.

mcqs.q: Milton's Comus was first performed in 1634 at:
mcqs.exp: Earl of Bridgewater ke liye Ludlow Castle mein.

mcqs.q: Samuel Butler's Hudibras is chiefly a satire on:
mcqs.exp: Presbyterian knight Hudibras aur squire Ralpho; Puritan hypocrisy ka mazaak.

mcqs.q: In Dryden's The Hind and the Panther, the 'milk-white Hind' stands for:
mcqs.exp: Hind = Catholic Church, Panther = Church of England (1687).

mcqs.q: Who is the hero ('King of Dulness') of the four-book Dunciad of 1743?
mcqs.exp: 1728 mein Theobald tha, 1743 mein Pope ne Cibber ko bana diya.

mcqs.q: Johnson's The Vanity of Human Wishes (1749) imitates:
mcqs.exp: London (1738) = Juvenal III; Vanity = Juvenal X.

mcqs.q: George Crabbe's The Village (1783) is a realistic reply to:
mcqs.exp: Crabbe ne Goldsmith ke idealised gaon ke against kadwa sach dikhaya.

mcqs.q: Which of these poems belongs to Blake's Songs of Experience?
mcqs.exp: London Experience mein hai; baaki teen Songs of Innocence (1789) mein.

mcqs.q: Coleridge's 'Frost at Midnight' (1798) is addressed to:
mcqs.exp: Paas sote baby Hartley ko sambodhit conversation poem.

mcqs.q: Byron's Don Juan is written in:
mcqs.exp: abababcc - ottava rima; comic epic, unfinished.

mcqs.q: Shelley's Adonais (1821) is an elegy on the death of:
mcqs.exp: Adonais = Keats; Spenserian stanzas mein pastoral elegy.

mcqs.q: Keats's phrase 'the vale of Soul-making' occurs in a letter to:
mcqs.exp: 1819 ka lamba journal-letter bhai George aur bhabhi Georgiana ko.

mcqs.q: Keats's 'camelion Poet' who has 'no identity' is described in a letter to:
mcqs.exp: 27 October 1818 ka letter Woodhouse ko.

mcqs.q: Tennyson himself called Maud (1855):
mcqs.exp: Tennyson ne baad mein subtitle diya 'A Monodrama'. 'A Medley' The Princess ka subtitle hai.

mcqs.q: Browning's The Ring and the Book is based on a murder trial held in:
mcqs.exp: Count Guido Franceschini ka case; Browning ko Florence mein 'Old Yellow Book' mili.

mcqs.q: Robert Buchanan's 'The Fleshly School of Poetry' (1871) mainly attacked:
mcqs.exp: Thomas Maitland naam se likha; Rossetti aur Pre-Raphaelites par hamla.

mcqs.q: Hopkins's Poems were first published in 1918 by:
mcqs.exp: Dost Robert Bridges ne Hopkins ki maut ke 29 saal baad chhape.

mcqs.q: 'Pied Beauty' by Hopkins is an example of a:
mcqs.exp: Curtal sonnet = Petrarchan sonnet ka 3/4 roop, 10.5 lines.

mcqs.q: Yeats's 'Leda and the Swan' first appeared in book form in:
mcqs.exp: The Tower (1928) mein, Sailing to Byzantium ke saath.

mcqs.q: 'Strange Meeting', in which a soldier meets the enemy he killed in Hell, is by:
mcqs.exp: 'I am the enemy you killed, my friend' - Owen.

mcqs.q: 'Break of Day in the Trenches', with its 'queer sardonic rat', is by:
mcqs.exp: Rosenberg, WWI mein 1918 mein maare gaye.

mcqs.q: Which poet called the 1930s 'a low dishonest decade'?
mcqs.exp: Auden, 'September 1, 1939'.

mcqs.q: Larkin's 'Church Going' appears in:
mcqs.exp: The Less Deceived (1955), Marvell Press.

mcqs.q: Seamus Heaney's 'bog poems' such as 'Punishment' are collected chiefly in:
mcqs.exp: North (1975); P.V. Glob ki The Bog People se prerna.

mcqs.q: Longfellow's The Song of Hiawatha is written in:
mcqs.exp: Finnish Kalevala jaisa trochaic tetrameter. Evangeline dactylic hexameter mein hai.

mcqs.q: Walt Whitman's 'O Captain! My Captain!' mourns:
mcqs.exp: 1865 mein Lincoln ki hatya par likhi gayi.

mcqs.q: Emily Dickinson's first collection, Poems (1890), was edited by:
options: Mabel Loomis Todd and T.W. Higginson
mcqs.exp: Maut (1886) ke baad Todd aur Higginson ne nikala; Johnson ka edition 1955 ka.

mcqs.q: Match List I with List II: (a) Hesperides (b) Lucasta (c) Silex Scintillans (d) Steps to the Temple -- (i) Henry Vaughan (ii) Richard Crashaw (iii) Robert Herrick (iv) Richard Lovelace
mcqs.exp: Herrick 1648, Lovelace 1649, Vaughan 1650, Crashaw 1646.

mcqs.q: Match the elegy with its subject: (a) Adonais (b) Lycidas (c) In Memory of W.B. Yeats (d) When Lilacs Last in the Dooryard Bloom'd -- (i) Edward King (ii) Abraham Lincoln (iii) John Keats (iv) W.B. Yeats
mcqs.exp: Shelley-Keats, Milton-King, Auden-Yeats, Whitman-Lincoln.

mcqs.q: Match the poem with its verse form: (a) Don Juan (b) Troilus and Criseyde (c) Ode to the West Wind (d) In Memoriam A.H.H. -- (i) rhyme royal (ii) ottava rima (iii) iambic tetrameter quatrains rhyming abba (iv) terza rima
mcqs.exp: Byron ottava rima, Chaucer rhyme royal, Shelley terza rima, Tennyson abba.

mcqs.q: Match the character with the poem: (a) Porphyro (b) Geraldine (c) Haidee (d) Demogorgon -- (i) Christabel (ii) Prometheus Unbound (iii) The Eve of St Agnes (iv) Don Juan
mcqs.exp: Keats, Coleridge, Byron, Shelley.

mcqs.q: Match the Yeats volume with the poem it contains: (a) The Tower (b) Michael Robartes and the Dancer (c) Responsibilities (d) The Winding Stair and Other Poems -- (i) September 1913 (ii) Byzantium (iii) Sailing to Byzantium (iv) The Second Coming
mcqs.exp: Tower 1928, Robartes 1921, Responsibilities 1914, Winding Stair 1933.

mcqs.q: Match the critic with the concept: (a) William Empson (b) Cleanth Brooks (c) Wimsatt and Beardsley (d) Harold Bloom -- (i) the heresy of paraphrase (ii) the anxiety of influence (iii) seven types of ambiguity (iv) the intentional fallacy
mcqs.exp: Empson 1930, Brooks 1947, Wimsatt-Beardsley 1946, Bloom 1973.

mcqs.q: Match the collection with the poet: (a) Relationship (b) Jejuri (c) Latter-Day Psalms (d) Summer in Calcutta -- (i) Arun Kolatkar (ii) Kamala Das (iii) Jayanta Mahapatra (iv) Nissim Ezekiel
mcqs.exp: Mahapatra 1980, Kolatkar 1976, Ezekiel 1982, Das 1965.

mcqs.q: Match the Frost poem with the volume: (a) Mending Wall (b) The Road Not Taken (c) Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening (d) Mowing -- (i) Mountain Interval (ii) New Hampshire (iii) North of Boston (iv) A Boy's Will
mcqs.exp: North of Boston 1914, Mountain Interval 1916, New Hampshire 1923, A Boy's Will 1913.

mcqs.q: Match the metrical foot with its pattern (u = unstressed, / = stressed): (a) iamb (b) trochee (c) anapaest (d) dactyl -- (i) / u u (ii) u / (iii) u u / (iv) / u
mcqs.exp: Iamb da-DUM, trochee DUM-da, anapaest da-da-DUM, dactyl DUM-da-da.

mcqs.q: Match the anthology or journal with the group/editor: (a) New Signatures (1932) (b) The Germ (1850) (c) Des Imagistes (1914) (d) Georgian Poetry (1912-22) -- (i) Ezra Pound (ii) Edward Marsh (iii) Michael Roberts (iv) the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood
mcqs.exp: Roberts ne Auden group launch kiya; The Germ PRB ka journal; Pound Imagists; Marsh Georgians.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Dryden's Mac Flecknoe is a mock-heroic poem. Reason (R): It treats the 'dull' poet Thomas Shadwell in the elevated style of epic.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Chhote/bekar subject ko epic style mein likhna hi mock-heroic hai, isliye R A ko explain karta hai.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Paradise Lost is written in heroic couplets. Reason (R): In his note on 'The Verse' Milton called rhyme 'the invention of a barbarous age'.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: PL blank verse mein hai, isliye A galat; R sahi quote hai.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Lyrical Ballads (1798) opens with The Rime of the Ancient Mariner. Reason (R): Wordsworth added a Preface to the edition of 1800.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Dono sach, par Preface ka hona Mariner ke pehle aane ki wajah nahi.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Shelley's Adonais is a pastoral elegy. Reason (R): It was written on the death of Lord Byron.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Adonais Keats par hai (1821); Byron 1824 mein mare.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Whitman's Leaves of Grass is written mainly in rhymed iambic pentameter. Reason (R): Whitman is regarded as the father of American free verse.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Leaves of Grass free verse mein hai, isliye A galat, R sahi.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Imagist poems favour precise, concrete images and economy of words. Reason (R): Pound's 'A Few Don'ts by an Imagiste' (1913) advised 'Use no superfluous word'.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Pound ka rule hi Imagist ki kifayati bhasha ka kaaran hai.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Dryden's Annus Mirabilis deals with the 'wonderful year' 1666. Reason (R): The poem describes the Dutch war and the Great Fire of London of that year.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: 1666 ki ghatnayein (war + fire) hi use 'year of wonders' banati hain.

mcqs.q: Assertion (A): Spenser dedicated The Shepheardes Calender (1579) to Sir Philip Sidney. Reason (R): Spenser's own shepherd persona in it is Colin Clout.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
mcqs.exp: Dono sach, par Colin Clout persona dedication ki wajah nahi.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order of publication: (i) Paradise Lost (ii) Absalom and Achitophel (iii) The Rape of the Lock (five-canto version) (iv) The Faerie Queene, Books I-III
mcqs.exp: FQ 1590, PL 1667, Absalom 1681, Rape of the Lock 1714.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order of publication: (i) Endymion (ii) Biographia Literaria (iii) Queen Mab (iv) Childe Harold's Pilgrimage, Cantos I-II
mcqs.exp: Childe Harold 1812, Queen Mab 1813, Biographia 1817, Endymion 1818.

mcqs.q: Arrange Tennyson's works in chronological order: (i) Maud (ii) In Memoriam A.H.H. (iii) Idylls of the King (first four idylls) (iv) Poems (two volumes)
mcqs.exp: Poems 1842, In Memoriam 1850, Maud 1855, Idylls 1859.

mcqs.q: Arrange Browning's works in chronological order: (i) Men and Women (ii) Dramatic Lyrics (iii) The Ring and the Book (iv) Dramatis Personae
mcqs.exp: Dramatic Lyrics 1842, Men and Women 1855, Dramatis Personae 1864, Ring 1868-69.

mcqs.q: Arrange Eliot's poems in chronological order: (i) Ash-Wednesday (ii) Prufrock and Other Observations (iii) The Hollow Men (iv) The Waste Land
mcqs.exp: Prufrock 1917, Waste Land 1922, Hollow Men 1925, Ash-Wednesday 1930.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (i) Crow (Hughes) (ii) The Less Deceived (Larkin) (iii) Birthday Letters (Hughes) (iv) North (Heaney)
mcqs.exp: Less Deceived 1955, Crow 1970, North 1975, Birthday Letters 1998.

mcqs.q: Arrange in chronological order: (i) Gitanjali (Song Offerings) (ii) The Golden Threshold (iii) Ancient Ballads and Legends of Hindustan (iv) Jejuri
mcqs.exp: Toru Dutt 1882, Naidu 1905, Gitanjali (English) 1912, Kolatkar 1976.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The marginal gloss of The Rime of the Ancient Mariner was added in Sibylline Leaves (1817)
Kubla Khan was first published in Lyrical Ballads (1798)
'Frost at Midnight' is addressed to Dorothy Wordsworth
mcqs.exp: Gloss 1817 mein juda; Kubla Khan 1816 mein chhapi, Christabel adhuri rahi.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Lycidas mourns the death of Arthur Hallam
Comus was first performed at Penshurst
Samson Agonistes was written for the public stage
Paradise Lost was rearranged from ten into twelve books in 1674
mcqs.exp: 1674 ka second edition 12 books ka; Lycidas Edward King par, Comus Ludlow mein, Samson closet drama.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Goblin Market was written by Swinburne
Aurora Leigh is written in heroic couplets
Sonnets from the Portuguese contains 44 sonnets
mcqs.exp: EBB ke 44 sonnets; Goblin Market Christina Rossetti, Aurora Leigh blank verse, Rubaiyat Persian.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Rupert Brooke wrote 'Dulce et Decorum Est'
Wilfred Owen's Poems appeared posthumously in 1920, edited by Sassoon
mcqs.exp: Owen 1918 mein mare; Dulce Owen ki, Mauberley Pound ki, Quartets Burnt Norton se shuru.

mcqs.q: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Frost's first book, A Boy's Will, was published in London
Ginsberg's Howl is dedicated to Jack Kerouac
Plath's Ariel was published in her lifetime
Leaves of Grass first appeared in 1865
mcqs.exp: A Boy's Will 1913 London; Howl Carl Solomon ko, Ariel 1965 (maut ke baad), Leaves 1855.
